ei.title: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By energetic work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to define it as the science of consciousness.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By ①<u>energetic</u> work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases ②<u>glandular</u>) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them ③<u>taking</u> the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to ④<u>define</u> it as the science of consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ taking → took (과거 시제 동사 필요)
det.analysis:
✅ ① energetic(정력적인): 명사 work를 수식하는 형용사로 정상

✅ ② glandular(선(腺)의): 명사 activities를 수식하는 형용사로, motor와 병렬 구조 정상

❌ ③ taking → took: 'they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive'에서 주어 some에 대한 과거 시제 동사가 필요. 접속사 and 뒤의 병렬 절에서 rebelled와 시제 일치 필요. 현재분사 taking은 서술동사가 될 수 없음

✅ ④ define: 'to define'에서 to부정사의 동사원형으로 정상
det.tip: 'they rebelled; and some...took the offensive'에서 세미콜론+and는 두 독립절을 연결하므로, took(과거 동사)이 와야 한다.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By energetic work, they had ①<u>proved</u> that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under ②<u>known</u> conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must ③<u>interpret</u> their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to define it as the science of ④<u>conscious</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ conscious → consciousness (전치사 of의 목적어는 명사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① proved(증명했다): 과거완료 'had proved'에서 과거분사로 정상. prove-proved-proved(proven) 활용

✅ ② known(알려진): 명사 conditions를 수식하는 과거분사 형용사로 정상

✅ ③ interpret(해석하다): 조동사 must 뒤의 동사원형으로 정상

❌ ④ conscious → consciousness: 'the science of conscious'에서 전치사 of 뒤에 명사가 와야 함. 형용사 conscious(의식이 있는)는 목적어가 될 수 없으므로 명사 consciousness(의식)가 올바름
det.tip: 전치사(of, in, at 등) 뒤에는 반드시 명사(구)가 온다: the science of consciousness(O) / the science of conscious(X). conscious(형용사)와 consciousness(명사)를 구분해야 한다.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and ①<u>limiting</u> it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By energetic work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were ②<u>warned</u> by the mighty ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by ③<u>insisted</u> that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to ④<u>define</u> it as the science of consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ insisted → insisting (전치사 by 뒤에 동명사 필요)
det.analysis:
✅ ① limiting: 'objected to defining...and limiting'에서 전치사 to에 이어지는 동명사 병렬 구조로 정상

✅ ② warned: 'were warned by'에서 수동태의 과거분사로 정상

❌ ③ insisted → insisting: 'by insisted that...'에서 전치사 by 뒤에 과거형 동사 insisted는 올 수 없음. 전치사 뒤에는 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 하므로 insisting이 올바름. ①의 'to...limiting'과 평행 구조(전치사+동명사)

✅ ④ define: 'to define it as'에서 to부정사의 동사원형으로 정상
det.tip: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(V-ing)가 온다: by insisting(O) / by insisted(X). 본문 앞의 'to defining...and limiting'과 동일한 구조(전치사+동명사)이다.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By ①<u>energetic</u> work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the ②<u>inferior</u> ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they ③<u>rebelled</u>; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great ④<u>mistake</u> ever to define it as the science of consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② inferior(열등한) → mighty(강력한)
det.analysis:
✅ ① energetic(정력적인): 동물심리학자들이 '정력적인' 연구로 동물이 좋은 연구 대상임을 증명했다는 문맥에 적절

❌ ② inferior → mighty: 동물심리학자들에게 '경고'를 보낸 사람들은 학계의 '강력한/영향력 있는(mighty)' 인물들이어야 함. '열등한(inferior)' 인물들이 경고를 보낼 권위가 없으므로 문맥에 부적절

✅ ③ rebelled(반발했다): 경고를 받고 '반발했다'는 문맥에 적절. 이후 공세로 전환하는 흐름과 연결

✅ ④ mistake(실수): 심리학을 의식의 과학으로 정의한 것이 '큰 실수'였다는 동물심리학자들의 주장에 적절
det.tip: 'the mighty ones in the science(학계의 강력한 인물들)'는 동물심리학자들에게 의식 기반 해석을 강요할 권위를 가진 학계 주류를 의미한다.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By energetic work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding ①<u>instinct</u> and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they ②<u>rebelled</u>; and some of the best fighters among them took the ③<u>defensive</u>, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great ④<u>mistake</u> ever to define it as the science of consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ defensive(수비적 태세) → offensive(공격적 태세)
det.analysis:
✅ ① instinct(본능): 동물의 '본능과 학습'에 관해 중요한 발견을 했다는 문맥에 적절

✅ ② rebelled(반발했다): 경고를 받고 '반발했다'는 문맥에 적절. 이후 공세로 전환하는 흐름과 연결

❌ ③ defensive → offensive: 'took the defensive(수비적 태세를 취했다)'는 문맥에 부적절. 경고에 반발(rebelled)한 후 '공세를 취했다(took the offensive)'가 올바름. 'by insisting that...(~라고 주장하면서)'라는 적극적 행동이 뒤따르므로 공격적 태세가 맞음

✅ ④ mistake(실수): 심리학을 의식의 과학으로 정의한 것이 '큰 실수'였다는 동물심리학자들의 주장에 적절
det.tip: 'took the offensive(공세를 취했다)'는 rebelled(반발)의 다음 단계로, 단순 거부를 넘어 적극적으로 자기 입장을 주장하는 행동을 의미한다. defensive(방어적)로 바꾸면 insisting(주장하면서)과 모순된다.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must __________ or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to define it as the science of consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 결과를 의식의 관점에서 해석하다 — 학계 주류의 요구 내용
det.analysis:
✅ ② interpret their results in terms of consciousness: 학계 주류(mighty ones)가 동물심리학자들에게 '결과를 의식의 관점에서 해석해야 한다'고 경고한 것이 원문에 부합. 'or not call themselves psychologists(아니면 심리학자라 칭하지 말라)'와 양자택일 구조

❌ ① publish their findings in academic journals: '학술지에 발표하다'는 본문의 의식 vs 행동 논쟁과 무관

❌ ③ abandon their research on animal behavior: '동물행동 연구를 포기하다'는 본문에 없는 극단적 요구

❌ ④ collaborate with human psychologists: '인간 심리학자와 협업하다'는 본문의 해석 방법론 논쟁과 무관
det.tip: 'interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists'는 '의식 기반 해석을 하든지 심리학자 명칭을 포기하든지'라는 최후통첩이다.

ch: publish their findings in academic journals
interpret their results in terms of consciousness
abandon their research on animal behavior

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동성 (그리고 경우에 따라 선(腺)성) 활동 — 관찰 가능한 행동의 구체적 내용
det.analysis:
✅ ③ the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities: 'that is to say(즉)'는 앞의 'their behavior(행동)'을 부연 설명하는 동격어구를 이끔. 행동의 구체적 내용이 '운동성·선성 활동'이라는 원문에 정확히 부합

❌ ① the emotional and cognitive responses: '정서적·인지적 반응'은 관찰 불가능한 의식 영역으로, 본문의 '의식을 관찰할 수 없다'는 논지와 모순

❌ ② the instinctive and learned patterns: '본능적·학습된 패턴'은 앞 문장의 'instinct and learning'과 겹치지만 'that is to say' 이후 행동의 구체적 양상을 설명하는 원문과 다름

❌ ④ the conscious and unconscious states: '의식적·무의식적 상태'는 직접 관찰 불가능한 내적 상태로, 행동 관찰만 가능하다는 문맥에 부적절
det.tip: 'that is to say(즉, 다시 말해)'는 직전 표현을 구체적으로 풀어 설명하는 동격 표지이다. behavior = motor/glandular activities라는 등식이 핵심.

ch: the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 불일치 — 동물심리학자들은 동물의 의식을 관찰할 수 '없었다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① '심리학을 의식의 과학으로 정의하는 것에 격렬히 반대' — S1 'objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness'와 일치

✅ ② '동물이 심리학 연구의 좋은 대상임을 증명' — S2 'proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study'와 일치

✅ ③ '학계 주류의 경고에 반발' — S4 'they rebelled'와 일치

❌ ④ S3에서 'they could not observe the consciousness of animals'라고 하여 동물의 의식을 관찰할 수 없었음. 성공적으로 관찰했다는 진술은 거짓
det.tip: S3의 'could not observe the consciousness of animals(동물의 의식을 관찰할 수 없었다)'가 핵심. 이것이 행동 연구로 전환한 근본 원인이다.

ch: 동물심리학자 집단은 심리학을 의식의 과학으로 정의하는 것에 가장 격렬히 반대했다.
동물심리학자들은 정력적인 연구로 동물이 심리학 연구에 좋은 대상임을 입증했다.
학계 주류의 경고를 받은 동물심리학자들은 이에 반발했다.
동물심리학자들은 동물의 의식을 성공적으로 관찰하여 중요한 발견을 이루었다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 일치 — 반발한 동물심리학자들은 인간 심리학도 행동 연구라고 주장
det.analysis:
❌ ① 동물심리학자들은 의식 관찰이 아닌 '행동 관찰'만 가능했음. S3 'could not observe the consciousness...could only observe their behavior'

❌ ② 학계 주류가 요구한 것은 '결과를 의식 기반으로 해석'하라는 것이지, 연구 중단이 아님. S4 'must interpret their results in terms of consciousness'

❌ ③ 학계 주류(mighty ones)는 의식 기반 해석을 요구했지, 행동 연구 방법론에 동의하지 않았음

✅ ④ S4 'insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior'와 정확히 일치. 인간 심리학도 동물 심리학 못지않게 행동 연구라고 주장
det.tip: 'no less than animal(동물 못지않게)'은 비교 표현으로, 인간 심리학에도 행동 연구 방법론을 적용해야 한다는 확장적 주장을 나타낸다.

ch: 동물심리학자들은 동물의 의식과 행동을 모두 성공적으로 관찰할 수 있었다.
학계 주류는 동물심리학자들에게 동물 연구를 즉시 중단하라고 경고했다.
학계 주류 인물들은 동물심리학자들의 행동 연구 방법론에 동의했다.
반발한 동물심리학자들은 인간 심리학도 행동의 연구여야 한다고 주장했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ② 불일치 — 동물심리학자들이 관찰한 것은 행동(운동성·선성 활동)이지, 의식 상태가 아님
det.analysis:

❌ ② S3에서 'could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities'라고 하여 관찰 대상은 운동성·선성 활동이지, 의식 상태(conscious states)가 아님

✅ ③ S4에서 '심리학자라 칭하지 말라(not call themselves psychologists any longer)'는 경고 — 일치

✅ ④ S4 끝에서 '심리학을 의식의 과학으로 정의한 것이 큰 실수(a great mistake)'라고 주장 — 일치
det.tip: S3의 'that is to say(즉)'가 행동의 구체적 내용을 '운동성·선성 활동'으로 한정한다. 의식 상태는 관찰 불가능한 영역이다.

학계 주류는 동물심리학자들에게 심리학자라는 호칭을 포기하라고 위협했다.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By energetic work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to define it as the science of consciousness.

det.korean: ① 동물심리학자들의 행동주의 심리학 운동
det.analysis:
✅ ① Animal psychologists' revolt against consciousness-based psychology(동물심리학자들의 의식 기반 심리학에 대한 반발): S1에서 격렬한 반대로 시작하여 S4에서 공세적 주장으로 귀결되는 전체 구조에 부합. 의식→행동으로의 패러다임 전환 촉구가 핵심

❌ ② The development of experimental methods in animal research(동물 연구 실험 방법의 발전): 실험 방법론이 아닌 심리학의 정의를 둘러싼 학문적 논쟁이 주제

❌ ③ The distinction between motor and glandular activities in animals(동물의 운동성·선성 활동 구분): 이는 행동의 하위 분류일 뿐 글의 주제가 아님

❌ ④ The historical conflict between animal and human psychology(동물심리학과 인간심리학의 역사적 갈등): 갈등이 아니라, 동물심리학자들이 인간 심리학도 행동 연구여야 한다고 주장하여 양쪽을 통합하려 함
det.tip: 글의 구조: S1(반대) → S2-3(배경: 행동 관찰만 가능) → S4(반발+공세적 주장) = 의식→행동 전환 운동

❌ ② The scientific establishment was justified in demanding consciousness-based interpretation(학계 주류의 의식 기반 해석 요구는 정당했다): 저자는 동물심리학자들의 반발과 공세를 서술하며 학계 주류의 정당성을 지지하지 않음

❌ ④ Human psychology and animal psychology should remain separate disciplines(인간심리학과 동물심리학은 별개 학문이어야 한다): 오히려 동물심리학자들은 인간 심리학도 '행동 연구'로 통합해야 한다고 주장함

det.tip: 'a great mistake ever to define it as the science of consciousness'는 가주어 it 구문에서 진주어 to define...이 뒤로 후치된 형태이다. ever는 '한번이라도'라는 강조 의미.

questions.passage: No one has objected so strenuously to defining psychology as the science of consciousness, and limiting it to consciousness, as the group of animal psychologists. By energetic work, they had proved that the animal was a very good subject for psychological study, and __________ regarding instinct and learning in animals. But from the nature of the case, they could not observe the consciousness of animals; they could only observe their behavior, that is to say, the motor (and in some cases glandular) activities of the animals under known conditions. When then the animal psychologists were warned by the mighty ones in the science that they must interpret their results in terms of consciousness or not call themselves psychologists any longer, they rebelled; and some of the best fighters among them took the offensive, by insisting that human psychology, no less than animal, was properly a study of behavior, and that it had been a great mistake ever to define it as the science of consciousness.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 채우시오. (영어로)
"동물의 본능과 학습에 관하여 중요한 것을 많이 발견했다."
[조건] (1) had, discovered, much, that, was, important를 반드시 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 중요한 것을 많이 발견했다 — 관계대명사 that + be동사 구문
det.analysis: S2에서 'had discovered much that was important regarding instinct and learning in animals'의 일부로, 6개 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열해야 한다. 'much that was important'에서 that은 관계대명사로 much를 수식한다.
det.tip: 'much that was important(중요한 것을 많이)'에서 much는 대명사(많은 것), that은 관계대명사이다. '많이 발견했는데 그것이 중요했다'가 아닌 '중요한 것을 많이'라는 구조.
